jobs.brief: EARLY STAGE: Abandoned husbandry corridor. Rows of open, empty habitat pens and low water troughs set BACK behind the catwalk, a large cracked glass rearing tank with a dark waterline at left-center, simple latches left ajar. Far left a recessed keeper's utility door, one small hooded amber lamp and a hanging empty feeding scoop: evidence of ordinary care, not a shop or cottage. Low masses of moss around tank bases, little foliage. Vast quiet gray-green walls and receding vertical cistern supports. Recognizable empty rearing troughs in lower visible band. Coolest and sparsest of the garden backgrounds.
jobs.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE production pixel-art battle background for ORVASK's THIRD DISTRICT, the RAIN GARDEN: abandoned animal husbandry and rainwater collection facilities INSIDE an enormous dystopian tower. The two input images are APPROVED art STYLE and battle-ground geometry references only. Do not copy their residential hut or furnace setting. Match their broad muted atmospheric pixel masses, deliberate 5–10 pixel-looking stepped edges on a 1672x941 16:9 canvas, grouped shadows, selective contours. Painterly pixel atmosphere but NO blur, smooth gradients, glossy detailed concept art, microtexture, noisy foliage, grain or dithering.
COMPOSITION LOCK: ONE continuous straight SIDE-ON level steel maintenance catwalk spans the entire width, its top foot-contact line precisely at y76% image height. Flat, no stairs, gaps or props obstructing the playing plane. Very thin subdued rail immediately BEHIND the floor, height no more than 4% canvas. Dark supporting beams and water-channel structure below. No foreground foliage over players. Damp muted sage, slate green, blue gray, weathered bronze, black-green depth and tiny restrained amber human lights. Foliage in LARGE broad silhouette clusters. Water reflects dim gray-green light, not bright white or luminous neon. Not a sunny forest; this is a threatening, abandoned life-support system with traces of former care.
The game displays a narrow horizontal crop roughly y46%–87% (wide screen y55%–84%). Place the location's recognizable architecture in that LOWER-MIDDLE band as well as above. Small player at x10%; four creatures stand x45%–96%. Keep x42%–96% y46%–74% calm mid-dark gray-sage atmospheric surfaces; avoid high contrast bright windows or foliage noise behind creatures and HP bars. Layer foreground platform / midground equipment / receding huge tower architecture. Sense of enormous interior height. No humans, creatures, eggs with creatures, statues, robots, weapons, text, letters, numbers, labels, UI, watermarks or visible sky. Opaque image. Keep a single clear ground line across whole width.

jobs.brief: MIDDLE STAGE: Overgrown nursery greenhouse. Tall fogged greenhouse panes with heavy thin iron ribs extending high beyond frame; broad dull olive leaves and two heavy hanging vines at LEFT and high edges only. A set of enormous terraced growing beds and broken shallow irrigation channels steps away into mist BEHIND the combat platform. Left-center one broad root has wrapped a cracked vertical water pipe; architecture still dominates. Lower part of glass ribs, root, irrigation beds visible in y50%–75%. Right half quiet milky sage glass and dark support posts, sparse foliage kept behind, no white lighting. One small warm caretaker lamp at far left. This is abandoned infrastructure, not decorative fantasy jungle.

jobs.brief: LATE STAGE: Great rainwater collector and sluice chamber. Massive ribbed stone-and-iron circular cistern housing at LEFT-CENTER; its very large OPEN sluice mouth and vertical water conduit descend into the visible lower band. Thin, dark muted sheets of falling water in the distance; restrained horizontal ripple reflections far below. Thick root cables cling to the chamber edges, a broken glass ceiling indicated by tall receding ribs above. Lower housing and large gate recognizable at y50%–74%. Right half remains quiet desaturated gray-green atmospheric depths for a large boss and escorts, no bright waterfall behind them. Far-left sealed maintenance doorway with small amber inspection lamp. The strongest sense of depth and neglected ecological scale, cool damp stillness, not furnace, magical temple or outdoor waterfall.

revisions.request: 상층 구역에 식물 느낌을 조금 더 보강
revisions.prompt:
Edit image 1, the existing upper Rain Garden battle background for ORVASK. Image 2 is a supporting reference for the already approved muted foliage pixel treatment. Image 3 is the actual game viewport COMPOSITION reference only; never copy its actors, words, HUD or cards into the background.

The user likes this setting but wants a little MORE PLANT PRESENCE in the upper stage. Keep it recognizably the SAME huge water-collection sluice chamber, same framing, colors, scale, water gate, distant architecture, warm door light, horizontal metal combat catwalk and railing. Do not redesign the scene or turn it into a forest. Increase vegetation in broad readable clumps so it looks like an abandoned botanical waterworks gradually being reclaimed by plants.
Specific edit: wrap two of the large left-center cistern pillars in thick irregular roots and moss; let draped fern/ivy masses hang from the cistern lip down around the left side of the falling-water opening, keeping the open sluice identifiable. Add broad low clumps of muted olive/sage aquatic leaves along the background water ledges and behind the left half of the battle platform, with a few soft foliage silhouettes on distant right columns. Vegetation must be perceptible in the actual CROPPED BATTLE BAND, especially source y400–670 and x260–900. Plants only at the top would be cropped out, so concentrate the additions lower around the sluice and its bases. Keep the right actor band quiet, mid-dark, with separated silhouettes, not a dense leafy pattern. Plants should feel natural and uneven; no evenly repeated decoration, bright flowers, glowing spores, individual leaf-vein texture, or tiny noisy leaves.
Preserve the existing coarse painterly pixel clusters and grouped light/shadow. No optical blur, no extra crisp black outlines or glossy highlights. Keep the original muted dystopian blue-green/slate atmosphere; olive leaf clusters should be visible without a blanket green tint over the whole image.
LOCK geometry: retain exactly the original 1672x941 wide canvas, platform top contact at y687, same completely flat unbroken catwalk from left to right and its rail. Do not put roots, leaves, raised objects or new shadows on or in FRONT of the walkable plane. Preserve the small warm maintenance doorway, the large open water gate and atmospheric interior depth. No characters, enemies, animals, icons, writing, frames or watermark. Opaque output. Output one edited whole background.
revisions.postprocessing: None. Generated PNG copied unchanged; source floor and geometry retained.
revisions.status: Integrated upper_v2; user requested more vegetation after positive overall feedback. Existing garden runtime suite: 1641 checks, 0 failures. Three upper-stage ratios, boss and finish screenshots reviewed. Physical Galaxy and user preference for this revision pending.
